```python
import folium
import pandas as pd

# 创建基础地图
m = folium.Map(location=[22.55, 114.12], zoom_start=12)

# 添加热点标记
hotspots = pd.read_csv('hotspots.csv')
for _, row in hotspots.iterrows():
    color = 'red' if row['severity'] == 'critical' else 'orange'
    folium.CircleMarker(
        location=[row['latitude'], row['longitude']],
        radius=row['event_count']/10,
        color=color,
        fill=True,
        popup=f"{row['type']}: {row['event_count']}起"
    ).add_to(m)

# 保存地图
m.save('ebike_hotspots_map.html')
```
